title: kube-policies audit record
description: Versioned, privacy-aware audit record (AUD-WU-17, NIST AU-3 / AU-3(1)). schema_version is stamped on every emitted record; bump it on any breaking change to this shape. When audit integrity is enabled each line on disk is a sealed envelope {"record": <this object>, "hmac": <hex>}; otherwise each line is this object directly.

request_received_timestamp.description: AU-8: when the controller received the request (UTC).

stage_timestamp.description: AU-8: when this audit record was emitted (UTC).

correlation_id.description: AU-12(1): correlates all records for one logical request across components.

event_type.description: Open set (not constrained). Common values emitted today: PolicyDecision, ConfigurationChange, ExceptionExpired, DashboardWriteAttempt, and other LogSystemEvent types.

user_info.description: AU-3 who: authenticated principal (Kubernetes authentication.k8s.io UserInfo).

operation.description: AU-3 what: CREATE/UPDATE/DELETE or a management verb.

source_ip.description: AU-3 where/source: the webhook's HTTP peer (apiserver/proxy hop), not necessarily the originating client.

apiserver_id.description: AU-3: kube-apiserver identity; correlated from the cluster apiserver audit policy (the AdmissionRequest does not carry it).

object.description: AU-3(1)/SI-12: the admitted object. Secret data and credential-like keys are REDACTED to [REDACTED] before persistence when audit.redact_objects is enabled (default).

old_object.description: Prior object on UPDATE; same redaction policy as object.

sequence.description: AU-9: strictly increasing record sequence in the tamper-evidence chain (present only when audit integrity is enabled).

prev_hash.description: AU-9: HMAC of the prior record (present only when audit integrity is enabled).
